policy: A reviewed official source may be accepted within its publisher, identity, language, displayed version, scope, and stated limitations. The current Lilex consolidation is an informational working text, not the legally authentic publication. Local-copy acceptance is separate from topic coverage, legal equivalence, and country completion. Reuse acceptance here is limited to statutory text under URG Article 5; it does not cover site design, database-level or systematic reuse, or unrelated content.
